ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v8p177/r2.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v8p177/r2.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v8p177/r2.claim: Noah is only a manifest warner, bringing sound proof that distinguishes truth from falsehood.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v8p177/r2.anchor: إن أنا إلا نذير مبين، ما جئت به بالبرهان الصحيح الذي يميز به الحق

RAZI-FULL:v24p133#2/r10.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v24p133#2/r10.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v24p133#2/r10.claim: Noah’s mission is to warn those who reject him; anyone who accepts is near to him, while one who rejects is distant, so the mission gives no grounds to expel believers.
RAZI-FULL:v24p133#2/r10.anchor: والمراد إني أخوف من كذبني ولم يقبل مني

BURSEVI:v6p212#2/r4.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v6p212#2/r4.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v6p212#2/r4.claim: Noah is only a clear warner to accountable people, whether elite or poor; expelling the poor to attract the rich would contradict his mission.
BURSEVI:v6p212#2/r4.anchor: أي ما أنا إلا رسول مبعوث لإنذار المكلفين وزجرهم عن الكفر والمعاصي سواء كانوا من الأعزاء أو الأذلاء

STUDYQURAN:26:115/r1.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:26:115/r1.speaker: author
STUDYQURAN:26:115/r1.claim: The clear-warner phrase is also used of Noah in several passages and of Muhammad in many others.
STUDYQURAN:26:115/r1.anchor: This phrase is also attributed to Noah in 7:184; 11:25; 71:2 as well as to the Prophet Muhammad in 15:89; 22:49;

STUDYQURAN:26:115/r2.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:26:115/r2.speaker: author
STUDYQURAN:26:115/r2.claim: A warner (nadhīr) is often paired with a bearer of glad tidings (bashīr).
STUDYQURAN:26:115/r2.anchor: often combined with being bringers of glad tidings

TAB-FULL:v17p603/r1.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v17p603/r1.speaker: author
TAB-FULL:v17p603/r1.claim: Noah says he will not expel those who believe in God and follow his message.
TAB-FULL:v17p603/r1.anchor: ما أنا إلا نذير لكم من عند ربكم أنذركم بأسه وسطوته على كفركم به

TAB-FULL:v17p603/r2.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v17p603/r2.speaker: author
TAB-FULL:v17p603/r2.claim: Noah is only a warner from his Lord, warning of punishment for disbelief; “clear” means he has made the warning plain and concealed no counsel.
TAB-FULL:v17p603/r2.anchor: ما أنا إلا نذير لكم من عند ربكم أنذركم بأسه وسطوته على كفركم به

TABATABAI:26:111-118/r8.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:26:111-118/r8.speaker: author
TABATABAI:26:111-118/r8.claim: The statement that Noah is only a clear warner explains why he will not expel believers or investigate their past to judge them: accounting belongs to God, not him.
TABATABAI:26:111-118/r8.anchor: الآية الثانية بمنزلة التعليل للأولى والمجموع متمم للبيان السابق

TABRISI:26:112-122/r7.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:26:112-122/r7.speaker: author
TABRISI:26:112-122/r7.claim: Noah will not bar people from faith because the objectors call them low-status; he is only a clear warner calling them to obedience.
TABRISI:26:112-122/r7.anchor: ما أنا بالذي لا يقبل الإيمان من الذين تزعمون أنهم الأرذلون لأني لست إلا نذيرا مخوفا

WAHIDI-BASIT:v17p86#4/r1.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v17p86#4/r1.speaker: ابن عباس
WAHIDI-BASIT:v17p86#4/r1.claim: Noah warns them of the Fire and clarifies what brings them nearer to God.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v17p86#4/r1.anchor: قال ابن عباس: أنذركم النار، وأبين لكم ما يقربكم من الله

WAHIDI-BASIT:v17p86#4/r2.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v17p86#4/r2.speaker: مقاتل
WAHIDI-BASIT:v17p86#4/r2.claim: Noah says he is only a clear messenger.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v17p86#4/r2.anchor: قال مقاتل: ما أنا إلا رسول بين

YAHYA-SALLAM:v2p512#2/r3.author: Yaḥyā b. Sallām
YAHYA-SALLAM:v2p512#2/r3.speaker: author
YAHYA-SALLAM:v2p512#2/r3.claim: Noah says he is only a clear warner.
YAHYA-SALLAM:v2p512#2/r3.anchor: {إن أنا إلا نذير مبين {115} قالوا لئن لم تنته يا نوح} [الشعراء: 115-116]

ELMALILI:26:105-122/r9.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:26:105-122/r9.speaker: author
ELMALILI:26:105-122/r9.claim: Noah describes himself as only a clear warner.

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:26:105/r1.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:26:105/r1.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:26:105/r1.claim: Noah’s call has the same essential principles as Moses’s and Abraham’s, and their peoples’ beliefs and responses to true religion were alike; the three narrative groups deliver the same message.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:26:105/r1.anchor: Sonuç itibariyle her üç peygambere dair âyetler grubunda da aynı mesajlar verilmiştir

SAMARRAI-ASRAR:r7#6/r13.author: فاضل صالح السامرائي
SAMARRAI-ASRAR:r7#6/r13.speaker: author
SAMARRAI-ASRAR:r7#6/r13.claim: Samarrai points back to an earlier discussion of differences among negation particles, citing these formulations and parallel statements that the speaker is only a clear warner.
SAMARRAI-ASRAR:r7#6/r13.anchor: وقد مر في باب التوكيد في التشابه والاختلاف في حروف النفي

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-5-english:p429/r1.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-5-english:p429/r1.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-5-english:p429/r1.claim: Noah will not abandon the believers to gain acceptance; as an open warner he has discharged his duty, and whoever rejects faith alone bears responsibility for that failure.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-5-english:p429/r1.anchor: As an open warner, he has discharged his responsibility. He who does not accept faith will alone be responsible for this lapse.

QIRAAT-ER:26:115:2#1/r1.author: QIRAAT-ER
QIRAAT-ER:26:115:2#1/r1.speaker: Qālūn, Ibn Kathīr
QIRAAT-ER:26:115:2#1/r1.claim: Shortening the final alif yields ana rather than anā; Qālūn and Ibn Kathīr are given as examples, with no semantic change but altered cadence.
QIRAAT-ER:26:115:2#1/r1.anchor: Canonical within the seven readings (e.g., Qālūn, Ibn Kathīr). The shortening does not alter meaning

ALUSI-FULL:v19p108#2/r1.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v19p108#2/r1.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v19p108#2/r1.claim: The clause explains that Noah is only a messenger warning accountable people and deterring them from what God dislikes, whether they are elite or low-status; he therefore cannot expel the latter.
ALUSI-FULL:v19p108#2/r1.anchor: كالعلة أي ما أنا إلا رسول مبعوث لانذار المكلفين وزجرهم عما لايرضيه سبحانه وتعالى سواء كانوا من الأشرفين أو الأرذلين

ALUSI-FULL:v19p108#2/r2.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v19p108#2/r2.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v19p108#2/r2.claim: Alternatively, Noah's sole duty is to warn with clear proof, already delivered; he need not appease some listeners by expelling others.
ALUSI-FULL:v19p108#2/r2.anchor: أو ما علي إلاانذاركم بالبرهان الواضح وقد فعلته وما علي استرضاء بعضكم بطرد الآخرين

ALUSI-FULL:v19p108#2/r3.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v19p108#2/r3.speaker: قيل
ALUSI-FULL:v19p108#2/r3.claim: One view takes both preceding clauses as the reply: pronoun placement after negation restricts Noah to warning, rejecting the claim that he follows their desires by expelling believers; the author notes a difficulty.
ALUSI-FULL:v19p108#2/r3.anchor: وقيل : إن مجموع الجملتين جواب وإن ايلاء الضمير حرف النفي يدل على أنهم زعموا أنه عليه السلام موصوف بصفتين

BAYDAWI-FULL:26:115-119/r1.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:26:115-119/r1.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:26:115-119/r1.claim: Noah is sent only to warn accountable people of unbelief and sins, whatever their status, so he should not expel the poor to attract the wealthy; alternatively, his duty is clear warning with proof, not expelling the poor to please his audience.
BAYDAWI-FULL:26:115-119/r1.anchor: ما أنا إلا رجل مبعوث لإنذار المكلفين عن الكفر والمعاصي سواء كانوا أعزاء أو أذلاء

BIQAI-FULL:v5p374/r12.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v5p374/r12.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v5p374/r12.claim: Noah is only a clear warner: he is not tasked with probing inward states or imposing demands on followers, and he explains his message without obscurity.
BIQAI-FULL:v5p374/r12.anchor: لا وكيل مناقش على البواطن , ولا متعنت على الأتباع

IBNABIHATIM:v8p2789#3/r1.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v8p2789#3/r1.speaker: ابن عباس
IBNABIHATIM:v8p2789#3/r1.claim: Ibn Abbas explains the warner as a warner of the Fire.
IBNABIHATIM:v8p2789#3/r1.anchor: ابن عباس نذير قال : نذير من النار

IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p162/r7.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p162/r7.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p162/r7.claim: Noah’s role as a clear warner explains why he cannot comply with the chiefs’ demand.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p162/r7.anchor: استئناف في معنى التعليل ، أي لأن وصفي يصرفني عن موافقتكم

IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p162/r8.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p162/r8.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p162/r8.claim: مبين derives from transitive أبان in the sense of making clear and explaining.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p162/r8.anchor: من أبان المتعدي بمعنى بين ووضح

IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p162/r9.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p162/r9.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p162/r9.claim: The restriction is additional and restricts the described subject to a single quality.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p162/r9.anchor: والقصر إضافي وهو قصر موصوف على صفة

IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p162/r10.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p162/r10.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p162/r10.claim: Noah’s similar exchange in Hūd may be a separate occasion or the same exchange retold with each Qur’anic account supplying complementary details.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p162/r10.anchor: حكاية موقف لنوح عليه السلام مع قومه شبيه بما حكي هنا وبين الحكايتين اختلاف ما

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p151/r4.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p151/r4.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p151/r4.claim: Noah's role is only to give clear warning; anyone who obeys, follows, and believes belongs with him regardless of rank or social standing.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p151/r4.anchor: إنما بعثت نذيرا، فمن أطاعني واتبعني وصدقني كان مني وكنت منه، سواء كان شريفا أو وضيعا

MUQATIL:26:112-118/r5.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:26:112-118/r5.speaker: author
MUQATIL:26:112-118/r5.claim: Noah says he is only a clear messenger and warner.
MUQATIL:26:112-118/r5.anchor: { إلا نذير مبين } [آية: 115] يعنى رسول بين

NASAFI-FULL:v3p192#4/r1.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v3p192#4/r1.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v3p192#4/r1.claim: Noah's sole task is to warn clearly with sound proof distinguishing truth from falsehood; the people remain responsible for their own course.
NASAFI-FULL:v3p192#4/r1.anchor: ما على إلا أن أنذركم إنذارا بينا بالبرهان الصحيح الذي يتميز به الحق من الباطل

QURTUBI-FULL:26:112-116/r12.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:26:112-116/r12.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:26:112-116/r12.claim: God did not send Noah to favor the rich over the poor; he conveys his message, and whoever obeys is fortunate before God, even if poor.
QURTUBI-FULL:26:112-116/r12.anchor: { إن أنا إلا نذير مبين } يعني: إن الله ما أرسلني أخص ذوي الغنى دون الفقراء، إنما أنا رسول أبلغكم ما أرسلت به
